razonamiento: The architecture shows an event collection and security rule evaluation pipeline. All components from the whiteboard correspond cleanly to AWS services or third-party tools mentioned in the narration: UserCompanyDataStream (representing the collection framework/source events), two Kinesis Data Streams (one for ingestion, one for the rule execution pipeline), Amazon Neptune for graph storage, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch and DynamoDB as backing/violation stores, CloudWatch and a custom Shard Service for operational scaling/sharding, and external alert channels (Slack, email, Splunk). All 11 visual lines are represented in the graph and mapped to their corresponding narration flows.
